latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Editor CapCut skill initial release.

- Edit raw video clips into polished, short-form 1080p MP4s, optimized for TikTok and Reels.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM (up to 500MB); fast, cloud GPU processing (1–2 minutes per clip).
- Automatic backend connection with token handling and free starter credits for new users.
- User-friendly workflow for upload, edit, preview, export, and credits management.
- Guides users with prompts and tips for best results; clear feedback for common errors.
- Backend session and status handling ensures smooth AI video editing and export experience.
